notes: ILLUSTRATIVE v2 STRUCTURAL example -- demonstrates the complete v2 data model, now schema-enforced by contracts/stitch_recipe_schema_v2.json and engine/schema.py's validate_recipe_v2() (Phase 2). Still not wired into any production code path -- see docs/recipe_model_v2.md. Numbers are grounded in the halter/corset top's mesh-panel regression fixtures (tests/golden/halter_mesh_row1_textbook.json, halter_mesh_row1_hand_swatch.json), which document expected engine behavior and real hand-crocheted observations -- including an unresolved discrepancy between the code's predicted DC count and the actual hand-crocheted count (see docs/recipe_model_v2.md section 11, question 1). Do not treat this file as CONFIRMED. name: Filet Mesh (halter/corset top mesh panel)

foundation_formula.notes: foundation_count = repeat_multiple * requested_repeat_count + additional_chains (calculator not implemented in Phase 1 or Phase 2). Reproduces both real golden fixtures exactly: 2*7+6=20 (halter_mesh_row1_textbook.json) and 2*3+6=12 (halter_mesh_row1_hand_swatch.json). additional_chains=6 covers row_1.setup's own foundation-chain consumption (SKIP 5 + DC 1 = 6); it adds no brand-new chain links of its own since setup contains no CH step here. This number is NOT re-stated as a row_1 action -- see docs/recipe_model_v2.md section 2.

later_rows.notes: UNVERIFIED BY PHYSICAL TESTING: this turning-chain counts_as value and later_rows.repeat's next_dc placement are v2 modeling choices, not confirmed conventions. The pre-v2 project code represented this same real turning chain as a literal 'DC 1, CH 1' step pair (see main.py's row_2 comment, 'chain 4 and turn -- counts as one DC plus one CH') purely to get the right produced-count arithmetic out of the old flat model -- it was never a real DC. counts_as is meant to replace that representational hack. The repeat itself is modeled here as 'CH 1, then DC into the next DC' (matching main.py's row_2 repeat_text 'CH 1, DC 1'), so the DC's placement is next_dc -- worked into the top of the previous row's DC stitch, not into a chain space. Whether {"DC": 1} + chain_spaces: 1 is the correct counts_as accounting for the turning chain, whether next_dc is really the right placement for this repeat's DC, and whether the turning chain's declared chain_spaces: 1 still means anything if nothing in this repeat is ever placed next_chain_space, all remain open questions for physical verification (see docs/recipe_model_v2.md section 11).

expected_swatch_structure.notes: Per-repeat count only (1 DC, 1 CH per repeat unit) -- does not yet attempt to reconcile the row-total DC-count discrepancy logged in data/concierge_log.csv (predicted 4, hand-counted 5, on a related but not identical mesh candidate). Structural demonstration, not a resolved reconciliation.
